allocator.instance: Local Program Director — deterministic policy branch (trivial case: exactly one configured eligible worker per role)
allocator.cognition_tier: deterministic; no local or frontier model consulted
authority_basis: Founder direction 2026-09-22 §5/§8: bind the canonical Allocator role; construct the exact bounded execution packet from existing authority and current configuration
SF-REQ-026 amendment: deterministic policy settles trivial cases without a model

selection.execution_path: existing factory lifecycle: Work Management READY → explicit Release → IMPLEMENT (PRODUCER) → VERIFY (VERIFIER) → REVIEW → ACCEPT → DONE, executed by the retained bootstrap (KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED, retirement matrix) with the live self-hosting profile

verifier.independence: separate GitHub identity and worktree; fresh verifier worktree retrieves the exact candidate SHA

selection.why: The only configured, doctor-validated workers; standing instruction of 2026-09-2x forbids changing provider configuration; Wave 1 PY-02..PY-09 executed on this path. Local-model allocation is not configured (SF-REQ-037 initialization is Wave 6); no escalation to a frontier model is needed for a trivial allocation.

alternatives_rejected.reason: bypasses the factory lifecycle and candidate custody (SWF-15: the coordinator does not hand a BIU to a provider CLI directly)
POSTW1-DECIDE-006A item 7 is REQUIRES_OPERATIONAL_PROOF; standing instruction: do not revert provider configuration

limits.policy: SWF-09: hard-enforced dimensions are wall-clock, attempts, retries, concurrency, cancellation; tokens and cost are measured, never assumed zero

concurrency.enforcement: bootstrap lane claim repository#issue:ROLE (synchronous check-and-reserve, ACTIVE_INVOCATION_EXISTS); WIP = 1

attempts.enforcement: Program Director records the cycle from authoritative transitions and withholds any further release beyond cycle 3 (deterministic); the bootstrap itself enforces no cycle cap

retries_within_phase.value: 1 replacement worker per phase on non-terminal outcome (does not increment the cycle, SWF-32 §6)
retries_within_phase.enforcement: liveness reconciliation (SWF-27) re-emits at most once per grace window; Director stops re-emission after one replacement

wall_clock.value: UNKNOWN — the bootstrap dispatcher enforces liveness inspection only (src/runtime/dispatcher.mjs scheduleInspection); no per-invocation wall-clock bound is enforced by the bootstrap
wall_clock.status: NOT_ENFORCED — declared honestly; whether this BIU may run without a hard wall-clock bound is for readiness/release to judge, not for this record to assume

cancellation.value: operator stop of the active invocation
cancellation.enforcement: operator control plane / bootstrap process control

tokens_and_cost.value: measured where the provider reports them; UNKNOWN otherwise; never zero

paid_provider_calls.value: subscription-funded worker sessions only; no API-key spend

remaining_allowance.basis: no numeric token/cost allowance exists in any authority (FACT: candidate budget.execution_allocation); attempts allowance = 3 cycles, 0 consumed

escalation.budget_exhaustion: cycle 3 verification rejection → HumanDecisionRequired via Decision Inbox (SF-REQ-035); no silent increase
escalation.architecture_question: Architecture Decision Required (AA A5) via Decision Inbox; branch stops
escalation.provider_capacity: classified PROVIDER_CAPACITY_INTERRUPTION, not a task failure; one replacement worker, then hold

not_granted_here: Wave 2 release authority (FD-01 §3; W2-P01). This decision binds who/what/limits; the Founder's Wave-authorization packet grants release.
